intent.statement: Implement Task 1 from 0_Planning/Multilingual_Local_Model_Speech_Blocks_Plan.md as the single replacement Speech Blocks span-ID contract for narrator+character Speech Blocks, including internal SourceSpan, SpeechBlockModelSelection, and validation-result types; reconstruct saved block text from source spans; reject or ignore model-owned rewritten text; reset/regenerate incompatible old partial state without preserving prior contract compatibility; preserve same-narrator mode.

examples: A model block with source_span_ids ['s001', 's002'] and rewritten text still persists exact source text from spans s001 and s002.
spec_items.statement: For narrator-and-character Speech Blocks generation, the model response shall identify ordered source spans by stable source_span_ids, and AudioMancer shall reconstruct persisted source_text and text from those spans instead of trusting model-owned text or source_text fields.

examples: A model block selecting ['s999'] or speaker_id 'missing-character' produces a validation failure instead of a persisted character block.
spec_items.statement: Speech Blocks validation shall reject unusable model selections, including unknown source span IDs, out-of-order source span selections, empty selections, duplicate selections that would reuse source text, and unknown speaker IDs.

Speech Blocks shall preserve the persisted Speech Block fields required by review, UI, export, audio generation, and scene-ambience insertion, while deriving spoken source_text and text from source spans.
spec_items.threshold: Existing same-file Speech Blocks tests that inspect persisted block IDs, approval fields, content_kind, speaker fields, source_language, source_text, text, warning_flags, and scene ambience behavior remain green after implementation.

examples: A running full-cast Speech Blocks state created before the span-ID contract restarts from chunk zero; a same_narrator state with valid boundary metadata still resumes from its recorded next chunk.
spec_items.statement: Speech Blocks resume shall treat narrator-and-character partial generation state created before the span-ID contract as non-resumable, but shall keep existing same-narrator boundary-ID resume behavior intact.
